authorization_scope: Adapt Titan strategy without weakening newer live rules

accepted_adaptations.rule: Record every reviewed runtime event with its contemporaneous decision and reason before acknowledgement. Preserve append-only history for EOD reconstruction.
Separate immediate entry rejection from momentum-watch eligibility. Extension alone may reject a chase without discarding a liquid leader that can form a new valid base or reclaim.

Rank executable opportunity using live structure, liquidity, participation, sector confirmation, catalyst integrity when applicable, and remaining move capacity; raw percentage gain is not the primary rank.
Maintain a downside board for qualifying underlyings. Execution remains limited to independently qualified single-leg long puts under all existing option rules; no short stock or spreads.

Treat a verified transformative catalyst as evidence that historical gap envelopes may be less predictive, while retaining live structure, ATR/chase, exhaustion, liquidity, dilution, risk, review, and protection gates.

At 03:55 ET refresh the full active common-stock/ADR universe and full-market baseline, process every eligible one-minute aggregate, and maintain quote/one-second subscriptions for 100% of symbols promoted by the broad watch gates without a top-30 truncation.

Persist the Trader Brain weighted opportunity score, evidence coverage, ATR-based remaining-move-capacity estimate, and preliminary trigger/stop/target plan for every promoted candidate. These artifacts rank attention only and cannot bypass complete live Titan or broker gates.

explicitly_excluded: same-day cash-account settlement restrictions replacing Limited Margin rules
any weakening of broker review, protection, loss caps, liquidity, dilution, manipulation, authentication, or no-overnight rules
